description:
Top Thrill 2 at Cedar Point is currently the world's tallest and America's fastest roller coaster.  Zamperla converted the former Top Thrill Dragster (original strata coaster built by Intamin) into Top Thrill 2.  The hydraulic launch was replaced with a multi-pass LSM launch and the world's largest spike.

This video includes footage from the 2025 and 2026 seasons.
